data.name: Muin
data.gender_notes: Muin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who provides support and helps others. The name Muin carries the meaning “Support, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muin usually hope their child will grow to embody support, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Muin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Support, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muin total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مُعِين
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُعِين هو اسم علم مذكر يعني المساعد والشريك، وهو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي ع-ي-ن، ويحمل هذا الاسم دلالة على القوة والصبر، ويُستخدم في التراث الإسلامي لوصف الشخص الذي يقدم المساعدة والدعم للآخرين، وله أهمية روحية في الإسلام حيث يُعتبر من أسماء الله الحسنى

in_urdu.name: معین
in_urdu.long_meaning: معین ایک مذکر نام ہے جس کا مطلب مدد کرنے والا ہے، یہ نام عربي جڑ ع-ی-ن سے نکلا ہے، اور اس نام کی روحانی اہمیت اسلام میں بہت زیادہ ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کے حسن ناموں میں سے ایک ہے

in_hindi.name: मुइन
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुइन एक पुरुष नाम है जिसका अर्थ मदद करने वाला है, यह नाम अरबी मूल ع-य-न से निकला है, और इस नाम का महत्व इस्लाम में बहुत अधिक है क्योंकि यह अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है

in_pashto.name: مُعین
in_pashto.long_meaning: مُعین د مذکر نوم دی چې معنی مرستندوی دی، دا نوم عربي ریښ ع-ی-ن څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او دا نوم د اسلامي روایت کې ډیر مهم دی ځکه چې دا د الله له ښکلی نومونو څخه دی

in_english.name: Muin
in_english.long_meaning: Muin is a masculine name that means helper and supporter, derived from the Arabic root ع-ي-ن, and holds spiritual significance in Islam as one of Allah's beautiful names, symbolizing strength and patience

data.cultural_impact: The name Muin holds great cultural significance in the Islamic community. It serves as a reminder of the importance of unity, support, and helping one another. In many Muslim cultures, people with the name Muin are seen as integral parts of their communities, often playing vital roles in fostering social cohesion and connection.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spiritual tradition, the name Muin carries profound significance. Muin is believed to represent a person who embodies the qualities of support, stability, and strength, both for themselves and for others. The name can be seen as a reminder for individuals to strive towards becoming a source of inner and outer strength for themselves and for those around them. This spiritual significance is rooted in Islamic principles such asself-improvement, compassion, and community, making the name Muin an inspiring and meaningful choice for parents and children alike.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Support, Helper" symbolizes One who provides support and helps others. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Muin serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of support, helper.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Muin ibn Harith was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Muin carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Muin was a prominent Sahabi (companion) of the Prophet Muhammad.
